The target's Standard Melee Attacks gain +1 to hit, +1 AP, and Magical Attacks.
 
 No model can be affected by more than one instance of this spell simultaneously.

rules.name: Chalice of Gold
rules.description:
The target gains one of the following Magic Items: Potion of Power Preservation, Potion of Healing, Dragon's Brew, Potion of Swiftness. 
See Common Potions and Scrolls.
 The target cannot gain an item that they already have unless it has already been activated.

The target suffers 2D3+1 hits with AP 4, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks,Zeal (against Metal Armour).
These hits always wound on 4+.

rules.name: Thunder and Lightning
rules.description:
All hits are resolved with Str 6, AP 2, Lightning Attacks, Magical Attacks. The target suffers 3 hits. Before removing casualties, apply [𝛼] 
[𝛼]: The target suffers 1 additional hit[𝛽]: Select a new Unengaged enemy unit within 6" of the target: it suffers 2 hits. Before removing casualties, select a 3rd Unengaged enemy unit within 6" of the 2nd unit: it suffers 1 hit.

rules.name: Foresight
rules.description: The target gains +1 Def and +1 Off.

rules.name: Immortal's Bane
rules.description: The target gains Divine Attacks, Magic Resistance (3).

rules.name: The Stars Align
rules.description: The target gains Hatred.

rules.name: Fate's Judgement
rules.description:
The target suffers a number of hits equal to the number of Magic Dice on this turn's Flux Card. 
Those hits are resolved with Str 4, AP 2, and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Augury of Triumph
rules.description: The target's side gains a bonus to its Static Combat Score equal to the Game Turn number.

rules.name: Inescapable Doom
rules.description:
Mark a Health Pool in the target unit, which has to be Rank-and-File if possible. Place one “Doom” Token on the marked Health Pool, and one at the start of each friendly Magic Phase. 
 At the end of any friendly Magic Phase, if the target is Unengaged, the Caster may end the spell. If so, remove all corresponding Doom Tokens: for each removed token, the marked Health Pool suffers 3 hits with Str 6, AP 2, and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Fountain of Youth
rules.description:
Choose one of the following effects for the target: 
 • One Health Pool in the target Recovers 1 HP. 
 • A Rank-and-File Health Pool of the target, Raises 2 HP. 
The Rank-and-File Health Pool cannot have a Single model unit limitation. 
 Each Health Pool can only be chosen 
 once per Magic Phase.

rules.name: Entwining Roots
rules.description: The target halves its Charge Speed and Mobility (rounding fractions up), and suffers -2 Agi, to a minimum of 1.

rules.name: Veil of Mist
rules.description: All units within 12" of the target when the spell is cast suffer a -2 modifier to their Casting Rolls except spells with Augment and a -1 to hit with Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Stone Skin
rules.description:
The target gains +1 Res.
In addition, Melee Attacks allocated against it never wound on better than 4+.

rules.name: Shield of Thorns
rules.description:
The target gains Parry.
 For each Standard Melee Attack allocated against the model that rolls a '6' to hit, the attacking model's Health Pool suffers one hit at the same Agility Step, with Str 5, AP 2, and Unmodifiable.

rules.name: Mud Slide
rules.description:
The target must immediately take a Dangerous Terrain (6+) Test, and treats Open Terrain as Dangerous Terrain (6+). 
 In addition, the target suffers -1 to-hit with its Melee Attacks.

rules.name: Whispers of the Veil
rules.description:
The target suffers -1 Res.
 
 No model can be affected by more than one instance of this spell simultaneously.

rules.name: Danse Macabre
rules.description:
The target gains Ghost Step.
In addition, it may immediately perform a Magical Move (4 Mob).

rules.name: Chorus of the Damned
rules.description: The target gains Distracting (1).

rules.name: Touch of the Reaper
rules.description:
Select one or two models in the target unit. 
Each selected model suffers a single hit that wounds automatically, with AP 10 and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Spectral Blades
rules.description: The target gains Dying Blow, and its Standard Melee Attacks always have at least AP 4, and gain Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Soul Blight
rules.description: The target suffer 2D3+1 hits with Str 9, AP 10, Magical Attacks, Psychic Attacks.

rules.name: The Devouring Dark
rules.description: The target suffers 1 hit with Area Attack (3×2), Str 5, AP 2, and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Blood Curse
rules.description: The target suffers −1 Def and −1 Off.

rules.name: Hand of Glory
rules.description: The target gains Aegis (6+) and Aegis (+1, max. 3+).

rules.name: Pentagram of Pain
rules.description:
The target suffers 3 hits with Str 5, AP 2, and Magical Attacks.
 If this spell causes at least one HP loss, the Caster of the spell Recovers 1 HP.

rules.name: Umbral Majesty
rules.description:
In each Round of Combat, one model in the target unit gains a “Majesty” model part, with Duration: Round of Combat. Select the affected model immediately before the “Majesty” model part allocates its attacks. 
The “Majesty” model part has the following Offensive Profile: 

Majesty69528.

rules.name: The Grave Calls
rules.description: The target suffers 8 hits with Str 5, AP 2, and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Fireball
rules.description: The target suffers 2D3 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Flaming Swords
rules.description: The target gains +1 to wound, Magical Attacks (Melee & Shooting), Flaming Attacks (Melee & Shooting).

rules.name: Dragon's Roar
rules.description: Choose a single model part in the target unit when casting the spell. This model part gains Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks,Magical Attacks) and Grind Attack (2D6, Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable).

rules.name: Pyroclastic Flow
rules.description: The target suffers 5D3 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Pillars of Fire
rules.description: Standard Melee Attacks from Rank-and-File models in the target are always Str 4 and AP 0, and gain Flaming Attacks,Magical Attacks, Automatic Hits, Fight in Extra Rank.

rules.name: Tidal Flame
rules.description: The target suffers 1 hit with Str 3, AP 0, Area Attack (55), Direct Hit (Str 6, AP 2, Multiple Wounds (2)), Flaming Attacks, and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Swarm of Insects
rules.description:
Immediately when the spell is cast, the target suffers 5D6 hits with AP 0 and Magical Attacks, and that always wound on 6+.
 In addition, it suffers -1 to hit with Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Savage Fury
rules.description: The target gains Fury,Fearless,Unruly,Frenzy.

rules.name: Awaken the Beast
rules.description: The target gains +1 Str and +1 AP.

rules.name: Predator's Instinct
rules.description:
The target gains +3" Cha and 
 Resistance (Ranged Attacks).

rules.name: Wild Guardian
rules.description:
Mark a Health Pool in the target. In each Round of Combat one model in the marked Health Pool gains a Guardian model part with Duration: Round of Combat. Select which model immediately before the Wild Guardian allocates its attacks. A unit can never have more than one Guardian model part. 
 The Guardian model part has: 
Guardian43633.

rules.name: Totemic Summon
rules.description: Summon a Totemic Beast (see profile below), and immediately place it on the Battlefield using Ambush (Target Point).

rules.name: Smite the Unbeliever
rules.description:
The target suffers D6+1 hits. All hits have Str 5, AP 2, and Magical Attacks. 
 • : select an different target, following the same targeting restrictions: that extra target suffers D3+1 hits. 
 • : select a different target, following the same targeting restrictions. That target suffers D3+1 hits.

rules.name: Light of Faith
rules.description:
The target adds +1 to the Combat Score of its side, and gains +1 Dis. 
 • : the target gains Courageous. 
 • : the target's Charge, Flee, and Pursue rolls are Minimised.

rules.name: Weight of Judgement
rules.description:
The target suffers -2 Def, and -2 Agi (Agi to a minimum of 1). 
 • : the target suffers -2 Off. 
 • : the target does not suffer −2 Def (i.e. it only suffers -2 Agi).

rules.name: Holy Affliction
rules.description:
The target suffers -1 to wound with its Melee Attacks. 
 • : the target suffers -1 AP 
 • : the target gains +1 AP

rules.name: Wrath of God
rules.description:
Place a marker on the target point. Do not roll for Divine Intervention when resolving the effects of this spell. You must roll for Divine Intervention at the start of each subsequent Magic Phase: 
 • : each unit within 2D6" of the centre of the marker suffers 2D6 hits with Str 5, AP 2, and Magical Attacks. Then remove the marker. 
 • : your opponent may move the marker up to 3" in any direction.

rules.name: Rain of Fire
rules.description:
The target suffers D3+1 hits. All other units within 3" of the target suffer 1 hit. 
All hits are resolved with Str 9, AP 4, Magical Attacks,Flaming Attacks,. 
 • : increase the number of hits each unit suffers by 1. 
 • : decrease the number of hits each unit suffers by 1.

rules.name: Mind Fog
rules.description:
Each Range Attack made by the target that fails its to-hit roll is instead allocated towards the attacking model's Health Pool with Automatic Hits.
 Each Standard Melee Attack made by the target that results in a to-hit roll of '1' to hit, is instead allocated towards the attacking model's Health Pool with Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Mirror Image
rules.description:
The next two hits the target would suffer are ignored. 
If the target is hit by several simultaneous hits, the owner of the unit chooses which hits to ignore. (Hits that are multiplied into several hits e.g. due to Fury or Area Attack) are ignored after multiplication.

rules.name: Illusory Paths
rules.description:
Choose which effect to apply when casting the spell: 
 • The target gains Random Movement (2D6"). 
 • The target gains Random Movement (3D6").

rules.name: Shrouded Steps
rules.description:
The target gains Hard Target (1). 
 In addition, it may immediately perform a Magical Move (6 Mob).

rules.name: Clouded Sight
rules.description: The target cannot draw Line of Sight to a target more than 12" away from it.

rules.name: Cauldron's Curse
rules.description: The target gains Weakness.

rules.name: The Dead Arise
rules.description: Summon a Skeletons or Zombies unit. Declare which when selecting the target for the spell. The unit has a number of Health Points corresponding to the Rsr value of the unit. All models must be placed within the spell's Range, with at least one model touching the target point.

rules.name: Echoes of the Dark Forest
rules.description:
The target gains Fearless.
In addition, it may immediately perform a 5" Magical Move. This spell may target units in Ambush. If so, the target unit immediately enters the Battlefied following normal Ambush rules, instead of performing a Magical Move.

rules.name: Black Wing Totem
rules.description: The target gains +2" Cha and +3 Agi.

rules.name: Blooded Horn Totem
rules.description: The target gains +1 Att and +2 AP.

rules.name: Clouded Eye Totem
rules.description: The target gains Hard Target(1), Magic Resistance(3).

rules.name: Gnarled Hide Totem
rules.description: The target gains +1 Arm and Distracting(1).

rules.name: Rune of Revocation
rules.description:
Ignore all other spell effects on the target from spells with Duration: One Turn. 
 The target unit gains Magic Resistance(2), which is also applied to friendly spells.

rules.name: Rune of Reckoning
rules.description:
Friendly models in the target unit gain Hatred. 
 Melee Attacks by friendly models towards the target gain Hatred.

rules.name: Rune of Oaths
rules.description:
Friendly models in the target unit gain Zeal. 
 Melee Attacks by friendly models towards the target gain Zeal.

rules.name: Rune of Resolve
rules.description:
The target gains Swiftstride and, until the end of the Player Turn, it also gains Light Troops. 
In addition, the target may immediately perform a 4" Magical Move.

rules.name: Rune of Gleaming
rules.description: The target gains Distracting(1),Hard Target(1).

rules.name: Rune of Resilience
rules.description: To-wound rolls against the target suffer a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Frostbite
rules.description: If this spell targets a friendly unit, the target gains +1 Armour. If this spell targets an enemy unit, the target suffers -1 Armour. {This spell may target two units instead of one (declare the additional target before the Casting Attempt).}

rules.name: Astral Union
rules.description: The target gains Regeneration(6+) and Regeneration(+1, max. 3+).

rules.name: Arise!
rules.description:
Choose one of the following effects, for each target: 
 • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises HP equal to its Rsr value. 
 
 • One model in the target Recovers HP equal to its Rsr value. 
 
 The following models cannot Recover more than 2 HP from this spell each Magic Phase:
 
 
 • Height 4--5 models with Solitary.
 
 • Characters and models with War Platform.

rules.name: Hellfire
rules.description:
The target suffers 2D6 hits with Str 6, AP 0, and Magical Attacks.
 

 *This spell can target units Engaged in Combat and in contact with the Caster's Front Facing.

rules.name: Guile and Fury
rules.description:
Can be cast in one of two versions:
 Augment:
 cannot be cast by Goblin.
 The target gains +1 to hit, and its Charge Range, Flee Distance, and Pursuit Distance are increased by 1".

 Hex: cannot be cast by Orc. The target suffers -1 to hit, and its Charge Range, Flee Distance, and Pursuit Distance are reduced by 1".

rules.name: Forest Embrace
rules.description:
Place a Forest* underneath the target until the last model in the unit is removed as a casualty. This Forest always extends up to the edges of the target's Unit Boundary (even if the unit moves or changes formation).

* You may place a marker next to the unit instead

rules.name: Chains of Pride
rules.description: The target gains Unstable and Fearless. {Targets with Supernal cannot take Break Tests.}

rules.name: Tempest of the Storm Witch
rules.description: The target may immediately perform a 12" Magical Move and loses Scoring. {In addition, the target gains Coastal Predator.}

rules.name: Spear of Infinity
rules.description:
The target suffers 1 hit with Str 2, AP 2, Area Attack(1×5), Magical Attacks, Direct Hit(Str 4, AP 3, Multiple Wounds(2)).
The hits from Spear of Infinity gain +1 Str for each spell successfully cast before this spell in this Magic Phase (including other instances of Spear of Infinity).

rules.name: Curse of the Phantom Queen
rules.description:
Attacks made by the target suffer -1 AP.
Attacks made against the target gain +1 AP.
Attacks from spells are not affected.

rules.name: Favour of Meladys
rules.description:
=1pt
The target gains 2 Protection Tokens, which are removed when the spell ends.
When a friendly unit within 18" of the target suffers a wound, after Armour Saves have been taken, but before any Special Saves are taken, the target may discard a Protection Token and ignore the wound applying the following rules:
 
 • Rank-and-File models of Height 1 ignore up to 2 wounds per token (provided they are suffered simultaneously). 
 • Characters, and models of Height 4 or 5, can each only ignore a single wound per phase. 
 • Wounds from attacks with Multiple Wounds are not ignored, they inflict one less wound instead.

rules.name: Curse of Nezibkesh
rules.description: The target gains an Incendiary Marker. In addition, it suffers -1 Def and -1 Off, as well as an additional -1 Def and -1 Off as long as it has 1 or more Incendiary Markers.

rules.name: Breath of the Lady
rules.description: Add 2 Blessing Tokens to your pool.

rules.name: Breath of the Steppe
rules.description:
Place a round Tornado Marker with a 3" diameter with its centre on the target point. The Tornado Marker must be placed more than 1" away from any unit. The marker is considered Covering Terrain for units inside and/or behind them that contributes to ⟨Soft⟩ {Hard} Cover.
 The Tornado Marker is Dangerous Terrain (⟨2⟩ {3}), even for models with Strider.

rules.name: Children of Umi
rules.description: All Melee Attacks allocated against the target suffer -1 to wound.

rules.name: Duty is Eternal
rules.description: The target gains +1 Res.

rules.name: Iovanis' Thunder
rules.description: The target suffers 2D3 hits with Str 4, AP 1, Lightning Attacks,Magical Attacks, Maniacal Enthusiasm(To-wound roll).

rules.name: Iovanis' Thunder
rules.description: The target suffers 2D3 hits with Str 4, AP 1, Lightning Attacks,Magical Attacks, Maniacal Enthusiasm(To-wound roll).

rules.name: Echoes of the Dark Forest
rules.description: The target gains Fearless. The target may perform a 5″ Magical Move. This spell may target units in Ambush. If so, the target unit immediately enters the Battlefied following normal Ambush rules.

rules.name: Brace for Impact!
rules.description: The target gains Fight in Extra Rank

rules.name: On The Double!
rules.description: The target gains +1″ Advance Rate and +4″ March Rate

rules.name: Ready! Aim! Fire!
rules.description: The target gains Accurate

rules.name: Steady, Men!
rules.description: Discipline Tests taken by the target are subject to MinimisedRoll. A unit that receives this Order and passes a Rally Test doesn't become Shaken, and the Reform that is made after Rallying doesn't prevent the unit from moving and/or shooting (but it still counts as having moved for shooting purposes).

rules.name: Ullor's Blessing
rules.description: The target’s unit gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks).

rules.name: Sunna's Blessing
rules.description:
The target’s unit gains Flaming Attacks.
 Each enemy unit in contact with the target’s unit when the spell is cast, suffers D6 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks.

rules.name: Volund's Blessing
rules.description: The target’s unit gains Zeal.

rules.name: Ullor's Blessing
rules.description: The target gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks).

rules.name: Sunna's Blessing
rules.description: The target gains Flaming Attacks. All enemy units in base contact with one or more targets of this spell when the spell is cast suffer D6 hits with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 1, Flaming Attacks, and Magical Attacks.

rules.description: The target's failed to-wound rolls with Melee Attacks must be rerolled.
